title: Raksha Rajya Mantri to inaugurate second Annual Trident Lecture of CENJOWS
body_text:
Raksha Rajya Mantri Shri Sanjay Seth will inaugurate the second Annual Trident Lecture of the Centre for Joint Warfare Studies (CENJOWS) at Manekshaw Centre, New Delhi, on September 1, 2026. During the event, RRM will deliver a Special Address on ‘Leveraging the Potential of Next Generation for Nation Building’.
As a part of CENJOWS’ anniversary celebrations, the Lecture is being organised on the theme ‘National Resurgence through the Lens of Defence Forces’. The programme will feature a Keynote Address by the Chief of Integrated Defence Staff to Chairman Chiefs of Staff Committee (CISC) and Chairman, CENJOWS, Air Marshal Tejinder Singh, on ‘Emerging Contours of Jointness and Integration’. Special Addresses will also be delivered by Lt Gen Raj Shukla (Retd), on ‘Civil-Military Fusion: The Way for National Growth’, and by Lt Gen Sandeep Jain, Vice Chief of the Army Staff, on ‘Fighting Smartly: Multi-Domain Operations and The Concept of Jointness’.
The Lecture will bring together senior leadership and eminent experts for deliberations on jointness and integration, multi-domain operations, civil-military fusion and the role of the Armed Forces in nation building.
CENJOWS, established in 2007 under the aegis of Headquarters Integrated Defence Staff, is a tri-services think tank that provides a forum for research, analysis and informed debate on issues relating to joint warfare, national security and the employment of national power.

enrichment.summary: Raksha Rajya Mantri Sanjay Seth will inaugurate the second Annual Trident Lecture of the Centre for Joint Warfare Studies (CENJOWS) at Manekshaw Centre, New Delhi, on September 1, 2026, themed 'National Resurgence through the Lens of Defence Forces'. The event will feature addresses by senior military leaders including the CISC Chairman Air Marshal Tejinder Singh, Lt Gen Raj Shukla (Retd), and Vice Chief of Army Staff Lt Gen Sandeep Jain on topics like jointness, civil-military fusion, and multi-domain operations.
enrichment.context: CENJOWS, set up in 2007 under Headquarters Integrated Defence Staff, is a tri-services think tank focused on research and debate around joint warfare and national security, reflecting India's ongoing push toward greater integration among the Army, Navy and Air Force. This push has gained institutional momentum with reforms such as the creation of the Chief of Defence Staff (CDS) post in 2019 and efforts toward establishing theatre commands, aimed at improving jointness, operational efficiency and multi-domain warfare capability. This particular release is a routine event announcement about a lecture series and does not itself introduce any new policy, scheme or decision, making it of limited direct examination value beyond general awareness of defence reform themes.
